_help: Look of the world: environment (tonemap, grading, SSAO, fog) and sky colours per time of day and realm. Colours are hex. Read by World.cs. 'toon' is the anime look applied to every mesh (Toon.cs).

genshin._help: Genshin-style shader on characters (Genshin.cs, assets/shaders/genshin_*.gdshader). enabled false = back to the plain toon look.
genshin._rampsHelp: Shadow colours, multiplied with the base colour: [deep shadow, shadow, saturated band at the shadow edge]; the lit side is white. Warm on skin, cool violet on cloth and hair; night ramps bluer. metalMin: materials less metallic than this get no metal bands or highlight (leather and cloth were glossy).

env._help: tonemapMode: 0 linear, 1 reinhard, 2 filmic, 3 aces, 4 agx. ACES with lower exposure and stronger contrast and saturation: deeper, cleaner colours (Filmic looked flatter in tests). A strong sun over low ambient gives the clear lit/shadow split of the Genshin look; little haze keeps distant colours clean.
